♻️ **DEBT**: This mark is a base64 PNG wrapped in an `<svg>`, unlike the ~60 sibling vendor icons which are real vectors.

<details>
<summary>Details and fix</summary>

The embedded raster is 64×64 (`AAAAQAAAAEA` in the PNG header) drawn into a `0 0 24 24` viewBox. The picker renders these at `tw-size-8` (32 CSS px), so it is already at its scaling ceiling on a 2x display and will be visibly soft on 3x. It also can't be recolored for dark mode the way `darkIcon` handles the other single-color marks, and it adds ~7 KB of base64 to every bundle that pulls `@bitwarden/assets/svg`.

Two options:

1. Source a vector LogMeOnce mark and convert it like the others.
2. Drop the `icon` from the `logmeoncecsv` entry in `import-source-picker-metadata.ts` and let it use the generic `bwi-key` icon tile, which is already the supported path for vendors with no art (`passworddragonxml`, `upmcsv`, `meldiumcsv`, `passwordwallettxt`).

Worth noting this file is also the only import icon without the `require-theme-colors-in-svg` eslint-disable header — it passes lint only because a raster has no fill attributes for the rule to inspect.
</details>

## 🤖 Bitwarden Claude Code Review

**Overall Assessment:** APPROVE

Reviewed the new `ImportSourceSelectComponent` in `libs/importer`, its picker metadata table, the per-client wrapper components and route wiring for browser/desktop/web, the two new browser guards plus the `filePickerPopoutGuard` change, the `ImportUpgrade` feature flag, and the ~60 new vendor SVG assets. Everything user-facing sits behind `FeatureFlag.ImportUpgrade`, which defaults to `FALSE`, and all four new i18n keys plus the pre-existing `noMatchingItems` / `appLogoLabel` / `search` / `continue` keys resolve in all three consuming locale files. The guard concurrency reasoning is sound — Angular does run `canActivate` guards in parallel, so the explicit auth check in `importUpgradeRedirectGuard` and the `/import` short-circuit in `filePickerPopoutGuard` are both necessary, and both are covered by tests. `AbstractThemingService.theme$` resolves `System` to `Light`/`Dark` before emitting, so the `darkIcon` swap is correct for system-theme users.

<details>
<summary>Code Review Details</summary>

- ♻️ : LogMeOnce mark is a base64 PNG wrapped in an `<svg>` rather than a vector like its ~60 siblings
  - `libs/assets/src/svg/svgs/import-logmeonce.icon.ts:4`
- ♻️ : Unreachable missing-parameter branch — `ParamMap.get()` returns `null`, not `undefined`
  - `apps/web/src/app/tools/import/import-source-select-org.component.ts:25`

</details>
